display_long_description:
**EXOSHOCK  - The Firefight Redefined.** 

Step into a **1–4 player co-op sci-fi PvE shooter** driven by one vision: to deliver **the most visceral combat**.

A hybrid co-op FPS **built for VR**, where **flat-screen players fight in your squad**. Full cross-play.
[media]
**COMMAND THE CHAOS** - You are a Division 9 operative, owned by the Basilisk Group. Board starships in transit, sabotage systems, steal data, and eliminate targets. Gear up, complete your Contract, get out, and return for another.
[media]
**REDEFINE THE FIREFIGHT** - Enemies flank, suppress, and push your squad. Reload under fire, strike with melee, and cover your teammates. Find an opening and turn a desperate fight around.
[media]
**ADAPT TO EVERY RUN** - Fight across three starships of varying sizes, including some of the largest maps ever built for VR. Semi-procedural objectives, six Resistance levels, and Contract Complications mean no two runs are the same. Face melee droid hordes, automated defenses, or hostile forces fighting each other.
[media]
**BUILD YOUR ARSENAL** - Complete Contracts to earn currency and increase your Arsenal Level, unlocking primary weapons, secondary weapons, and items. Customize your armor, colors, patterns, and patches.
[media]
**VR & PC. SAME SQUAD.** - Play solo or team up with friends in 4-player co-op. AI teammates fill the remaining squad slots. Solo play is also available completely offline.

**JUST THE BEGINNING** - Early Access is our foundation. Expect some bugs and rough edges as we expand, refine, and improve EXOSHOCK with the community.
